title: Assemble eigenvalue matrix functions
action: Implement the construction of the diagonal matrix F(neff) and the full coupling matrix T0(neff) using cylindrical Bessel, Neumann, and modified Bessel functions, translation matrices, and the given fiber parameters. This implements the determinant equation |F+T0|=0 from the paper’s semianalytical derivation, truncating the azimuthal expansions at m=±12.
description: Required intermediate: prepares the matrix-valued functions that subsequent root-finding and field reconstruction depend on. No separate output file.

title: Solve cladding mode effective indices (dual-core and coreless) and their difference
action: Numerically search for roots of det(F(neff)+T0(neff))=0 to locate the effective indices corresponding to LP03′, LP04′, and LP06′ modes (dual-core). Additionally, compute the effective indices for the coreless fiber (two-layer model with n1=n3, d1=d2=0, cores absent) for LP03, LP04, LP06 by solving the standard three-layer eigenvalue equation with the same cladding parameters. Compute the signed difference delta_n_eff = n_eff (dual-core) - n_eff (coreless) for each mode. Write the mode identifiers and the three numerical values per mode (n_eff, n_eff_coreless, delta_n_eff) to CSV with six decimal places.
description: Scored artifact containing the computed dual-core and coreless effective indices and their differences for the three target cladding modes.
output_schema: mode (str): LP03', LP04', LP06'; n_eff (float): dual-core effective index (6 decimal places); n_eff_coreless (float): coreless effective index (6 decimal places); delta_n_eff (float): signed difference n_eff - n_eff_coreless (6 decimal places)

title: Compute radial field profile for LP03' mode
action: Using the effective index obtained for the LP03′ mode, reconstruct the normalized field amplitude along the radial direction at azimuthal angles θ=0 and θ=π. Normalize the field appropriately and sample r from 0 to 62.5 µm. Write the data to CSV.
description: Scored artifact containing the normalized radial field profile of the LP03' mode, demonstrating the non‑azimuthally symmetric intensity distribution.
output_schema: r_um (float): radial coordinate in µm; amplitude_theta0 (float): normalized field amplitude at θ=0; amplitude_theta_pi (float): normalized field amplitude at θ=π
